description: Source code implementing a preload data decoder with bit reading, size decoding, and Huffman decoding functionalities, used for search and prefix matching within a network-related project.

classes.name: PreloadDecoder::BitReader
classes.description: Class for reading bits from a byte stream, supporting next bit retrieval, multiple bits reading, size decoding, and seeking.

classes.name: PreloadDecoder::HuffmanDecoder
classes.description: Class for decoding Huffman-encoded data using a provided Huffman tree.

methods.name: PreloadDecoder::BitReader::Next
methods.description: Retrieves the next bit from the input stream.

methods.name: PreloadDecoder::BitReader::Read
methods.description: Reads a specified number of bits from the input stream into an output variable.

methods.name: PreloadDecoder::BitReader::DecodeSize
methods.description: Decodes a size value from the bit stream based on a custom encoding scheme.

methods.name: PreloadDecoder::BitReader::Seek
methods.description: Seeks to a specific bit offset within the input stream.

methods.name: PreloadDecoder::HuffmanDecoder::Decode
methods.description: Decodes a character from Huffman-encoded data using the Huffman tree.
